input.query: refresh token rotation exchange for new token pair

content.text: The refresh code calls `sessionService.updateByHash`, so I'll read that next.

candidates.explanation: updateByHash takes a conditions object with both id and hash, but the relational implementation filters only on `{ id: Number(conditions.id) }`. It ignores `conditions.hash`. After a refresh the session hash changes, but a replayed old refresh token (carrying the old hash) still matches the session by id. The update succeeds and a new token pair is issued. The document (Mongo) implementation correctly filters on both `_id` and `hash`.

Rotation relies entirely on updateByHash returning null when the presented hash doesn't match the current session hash. Because the repository ignores the hash, this check never rejects a stale refresh token.

fix.description: Include the hash in the update's where clause so that a stale hash affects no rows and updateByHash returns null: `update({ id: Number(conditions.id), hash: conditions.hash }, { hash: payload.hash })`.
